title: CLI: apricity export --daw-set with -o, --library, --no-collect, --force and located errors
description:
## Intent

The command: `apricity export --daw-set <score>`.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-cli/src/export.rs` and a `Cmd::Export` variant in `crates/apricity-cli/src/main.rs`: `apricity export --daw-set <score> [-o <path.als or folder>] [--library <dir>] [--no-collect] [--force]`. Default output: `<score stem> Project/<score stem>.als` beside the current directory. The `export` subcommand is shaped so `--kit` and `--clips` (apricitus-5562e0) can join it.
- `--help` text for every flag, in the house voice (see `Render`).
- Errors: compile errors printed exactly as `apricity compile` prints them (with line and column for `.apr`); export errors name the score line (via the DSL source map where the problem traces to a line) or the track/clip and the file path. Relates to apricitus-38a9a4 (structured compile errors).
- Write into a temporary folder beside the target and rename at the end, so a failure leaves nothing; refuse an existing target without `--force`.
- Summary line on success: tracks, clips, locators, samples copied (count and size), warnings.
- CLI tests: `crates/apricity-cli/tests/export_cli.rs` (exit codes, `--help`, existing target, unwritable folder).

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test export_cli` and `cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — the mistakes scenarios pass; `./target/debug/apricity export --help` reads well.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): apricity export --daw-set`. Not breaking (new subcommand).

comments.text: After writer API review, Terra 6.1 medium will integrate compile paths, project staging, source probe and collection, safe force replacement and located errors. The CLI remains the entry point for executable acceptance.
